title: 最小权限判定器：(用户,主机,动作,库,表) -> ALLOW/DENY
expected_output:
=== 最小权限判定器: (用户, 主机, 动作, 库, 表) -> 允许/拒绝 ===
授权表 5 条:

code:
import re

# 授权表: (用户, 主机, 动作, 库, 表, 是否带 GRANT OPTION)
GRANTS = [
    ("app", "10.0.0.5", "SELECT", "shop", "orders", 0),
    ("app", "10.0.0.5", "SELECT", "shop", "order_item", 0),
    ("report", "%", "SELECT", "shop", "*", 0),
    ("ops", "10.0.0.%", "ALL", "shop", "*", 1),
    ("readonly", "10.0.0.7", "SELECT", "shop", "*", 0),
]
ALL_ACTIONS = ("SELECT", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE")


def host_match(grant_host, req_host):
    """MySQL 主机匹配：% 为任意串通配符。"""
    pat = "^" + re.escape(grant_host).replace("%", ".*") + "$"
    return re.match(pat, req_host) is not None


def table_match(grant_table, req_table):
    if grant_table == "*":
        return True
    pat = "^" + re.escape(grant_table).replace("%", ".*") + "$"
    return re.match(pat, req_table) is not None


def action_match(grant_action, req_action):
    return grant_action == "ALL" or grant_action == req_action


def decide(user, host, action, db, table):
    """返回 (是否允许, 命中的授权条目列表)。未被授权 = 拒绝(最小权限)。"""
    hits = []
    for g_user, g_host, g_action, g_db, g_table, g_opt in GRANTS:
        if g_user != user:
            continue
        if not host_match(g_host, host):
            continue
        if g_db != db:
            continue
        if not table_match(g_table, table):
            continue
        if not action_match(g_action, action):
            continue
        hits.append("%s@%s:%s ON %s.%s" % (g_user, g_host, g_action, g_db, g_table))
    return bool(hits), hits


CASES = [
    ("app", "10.0.0.5", "SELECT", "shop", "orders"),
    ("app", "10.0.0.5", "DELETE", "shop", "orders"),
    ("app", "10.0.0.5", "SELECT", "shop", "customers"),
    ("app", "10.0.0.9", "SELECT", "shop", "orders"),
    ("report", "192.168.1.20", "SELECT", "shop", "orders"),
    ("report", "192.168.1.20", "SELECT", "crm", "customers"),
    ("ops", "10.0.0.42", "DELETE", "shop", "orders"),
    ("ops", "10.0.1.9", "DELETE", "shop", "orders"),
    ("readonly", "10.0.0.7", "UPDATE", "shop", "orders"),
]

print("=== 最小权限判定器: (用户, 主机, 动作, 库, 表) -> 允许/拒绝 ===")
print("授权表 %d 条:" % len(GRANTS))
for g in GRANTS:
    print("  GRANT %s ON %s.%s TO '%s'@'%s'%s" % (
        g[2], g[3], g[4], g[0], g[1], " WITH GRANT OPTION" if g[5] else ""))

allow = deny = 0
print("-" * 62)
print("%-9s %-12s %-7s %-8s %-12s %s" % ("用户", "主机", "动作", "库", "表", "判定"))
for user, host, action, db, table in CASES:
    ok, hits = decide(user, host, action, db, table)
    allow += 1 if ok else 0
    deny += 0 if ok else 1
    print("%-9s %-12s %-7s %-8s %-12s %s" % (
        user, host, action, db, table, "ALLOW" if ok else "DENY"))
    print("          命中: %s" % (", ".join(hits) if hits else "(无匹配授权, 默认拒绝)"))

print("-" * 62)
print("允许 %d 条 / 拒绝 %d 条" % (allow, deny))
print("关键判据: 默认拒绝(default-deny) + 主机也参与匹配")
print("app 只被授予 shop.orders / shop.order_item 的表级 SELECT,")
print("故 SELECT shop.customers 被拒绝 —— 表级授权不会「升格」成库级授权")
